verdict.rationale: Anthropic Skills supports team-wide distribution via committed SKILL.md files in shared repos, git-based plugin marketplaces (`/plugin marketplace add`), and installable plugins bundling skills/agents/hooks, with centralized discovery, versioning, and auto-updates documented. Community evidence shows real-world use of shared skill repos (e.g., xlsx skill) and org-level customization (brand guidelines, workflows), corroborating practical distribution. missing for 10: no independent case study of an engineering team formally rolling out a marketplace org-wide, and community reports raise reliability concerns about skills being triggered consistently once distributed.
